discussion.body:
Concept art and character sketch from the FEAT-052 lock. No status change. HEAD not moved.
Act 0 boss plate: short squat turtle-like body, huge bald blue-gray head, inflamed red-rimmed wet eyes, wide irregular toothy mouth, olive plastron, dark back shell, spiral tail. Harvest-road dusk field.
Sketch sheet: front, 3/4, and face close-up with material callouts.
Local files: Concept art/FEAT-052-act0-boss-concept.jpg, Concept art/FEAT-052-act0-boss-sketch.jpg.
